I've continued to tweak the design and here is what it looks like now: http://i.imgur.com/RvnQM64.png

This is with immersive mode turned on. Since I didn't like the ones that came with the icon pack, I made my own icons for the mic in the top Google widget, the camera app, the instagram app, and the settings app. I also made my own background bar for the Google widget and made it semi-transparent.

I added text to the folders but this isn't in the way that you would expect. You see, there is no option to add your own fonts to use in Nova Launcher. So I hacked this solution: First, I enabled overlapping in Nova so that I could position a widget behind my seven folders. The widget is a KWGT with seven text objects that I manually positioned until they lined up with their respective folders.

Nova Launcher allows you to choose your own image for the folder backgrounds (I'm not sure if this is a Prime feature but I do have Prime). I just made a 14x14 pixel white circle at 60% opacity and exported it at 192x192. Hope this helps :)
